title: Declining to name the trumpet player
summary: Montgomery asks whether the Senegal trumpeter was Bobby Hackett; Bushell says no and will not name him on tape.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Can I ask you -- the trumpet player you were speaking about that performed with Jackie Gleason, was that Bobby Hackett?
Oh, no, no. I played with Bobby in Puerto Rico. No, that wasn't Bobby.
The late Bobby Hackett, it wasn't him?
No, no, Bobby was a great guy. Bobby
wouldn't do a thing like that. This guy that did that, you know you've heard his name -- but I'm a little reluctant to mention his name on tape.
Okay. And after you finished your tour there in Africa --
